answer.reason: The supplied draft (A) is consistent with the known scale of California's QCEW-covered NAICS 54 employment. Professional, scientific, and technical services is one of California's largest private sectors, with covered employment running on the order of 1.4 million jobs (the professional and business services supersector is roughly 3 million, of which NAICS 54 accounts for the largest share). A December 2024 level of 1,405,205 covered jobs fits this magnitude, whereas 897,501 (option B) is far below the established size of this sector in California and is implausible for statewide NAICS 54. I cannot recompute the exact figure from the CSV because the data file contents were not supplied, but the option magnitudes are decisively distinguishable, so A is the supported choice.
